summary: Decoupled 7 of 9 B12_management_console_read_models test files from services/control-plane/bff/main.py via existing production domain routers (management_read_models.router, control_loops.router, incidents.router, governance.router, research.router, console_gap.route_policies, console_gap.workflows_hooks, jobs.router) and the already-decoupled rebalance_authority_test_support.py fixture, with 0 net main.py imports across the batch and only 1 sys.path mutation (test_console_data_ooda_projection.py, scoped to importing the unrelated standalone scripts/project_ooda_to_bff_surfaces.py script, not main.py). Retained composition imports for 2 files (test_mgmt_ooda_004_bff_routes.py, test_management_read_budget.py) whose assertions are fundamentally about behavior/private helpers that still live only in main.py and are not yet extracted into the router/service modules, matching the RETAINED_COMPOSITION precedent from BFF-TEST-MIGRATION-B04-SECURITY-ERROR-IDEMPOTENCY-001. test_management_read_models_router.py additionally retains 2 sys.path mutations and 2 dynamic importlib.import_module calls scoped strictly inside its pre-existing _import_main_for_inventory() helper, whose sole purpose (3 AST/route-ownership tests) is diffing the extracted router module against main.py itself -- that is the test's function, not an incomplete decouple. 83 of 92 tests pass; the remaining 9 failures are pre-existing production/test drift verified identical on the unmodified originals (git-stash isolated and re-run individually) and are unrelated to this wiring migration -- one such original failure (test_downstream_probe_failures_stay_on_downstream_health_surface) is fixed as a side effect of more correct dependency injection.

services/control-plane/bff/test_mgmt_ood.production_wiring: Package-qualified `from services.control_plane.bff import main as bff_main` (sys.path hack removed); routes under test (/bff/runtimes/{id}/ooda, /bff/strategies/{id}/ooda, /bff/evolution-programs/{id}/ooda) are reachable only via runtime/router.py's create_runtime_router(), whose RuntimeRouterService has no fallback defaults -- every one of ~30 dependencies is assembled only as closures inside main.py (main.py:19614-19658). Reimplementing that composition graph in a test file would duplicate production wiring rather than reuse it, matching the RETAINED_COMPOSITION precedent from B04.

services.control_plane.bff.control_loops.router.create_control_loops_router(read_surface=store) mounted on a fresh FastAPI(); /bff/v5/control-room is self-contained in ControlLoopsService.control_room()/_ooda_status().
services/control-plane/bff/test_mgmt_ood.test_failure_disposition: 5 pre-existing failures verified identical on the unmodified bff_main-coupled original via git-stash isolation. The live /bff/v5/control-room route (owned solely by control_loops/router.py) returns a simpler ooda_status shape (no per-stage `stages` dict, no `surface_key` in meta) than this test expects. A richer implementation (_build_ooda_control_room_status_card, main.py:18844) exists but is dead code for this HTTP route -- its only real caller is assistant/source_collectors.py's internal AI-assistant data collector, not the registered FastAPI endpoint. Router/service and this contract test have drifted apart from main.py; not caused by this migration. Worth a follow-up corrective task.
